The loss of a scoring system was kind of a disappointment for me in the Megaman series.

It's one thing to just pass the stage, it's another to do it fast, and yet another to do it with a higher score just as fast. There are a few points in Megaman games where it's just easier to run past enemies or take a hit or two, but score discourages that since you don't get points for unkilled stuff. Moreover, picking up those little orbs means it's not enough to destroy an enemy but also do so without the drop falling into a pit or on spikes.

Unfortunately, what made the scoring in the first game absolute bullshit was the variable score for clearing a stage. And, IIRC, if you beat the game, it loops and brings you back to the menu to play some more. So it can become kind of an endurance test to see how far you can go on your initial three lives.
